core_principles: Content is King: The editor canvas is sacred space.
Fusion over Imitation: Linear's precision x Notion's flexibility.
Density with Breath: High-density sidebar/settings, low-density writing area.
Tactile Feedback: Micro-interactions on every hover, click, and drag.

editor_canvas.styles: max-w-3xl mx-auto min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] py-12 focus:outline-none prose prose-invert prose-headings:font-display prose-a:text-brand

sidebar.styles: h-screen border-r border-border bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 flex flex-col
sidebar.item_style: group flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground
sidebar.active_item_style: bg-brand/10 text-brand font-semibold relative after:absolute after:left-0 after:h-4 after:w-1 after:bg-brand after:rounded-r-full

settings_panel.styles: h-screen border-l border-border bg-card/30 backdrop-blur-md p-4 hidden xl:block w-[300px] sticky top-0
settings_panel.section_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-3 mt-6 first:mt-0

toolbar.styles: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 h-12 px-4 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl rounded-full flex items-center gap-1 z-50 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 fade-in duration-300
toolbar.button_style: p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors

cards.base: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-border/80 transition-all duration-300

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor the monolith editor into `EditorLayout`, `Sidebar`, `EditorCanvas`, `SettingsPanel` components.
Implement the layout using CSS Grid for the main structure.
Ensure the Brand Color #00A1B2 is used sparingly for accents (active states, primary buttons, links), NOT for main backgrounds.
Use the 'Glassmorphism' tokens from index.css for panels and overlays.
The 'Preview' functionality should be a toggle or a separate view mode, not always a split screen, to allow focus.
Respect the 'Dark Theme' defaults in index.css but ensure Light Mode overrides work correctly via Tailwind classes.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Do NOT apply universal transition: all.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures/noise overlays are encouraged.
